scenes.title: 照片里的人去哪儿了？
tags: Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone
Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
quotes: I've got about six of him.
我大概已经有六张他了。
Well, you can't expect him to hang around all day, can you?
你总不能指望他整天都待在那儿吧？

scenes.title: 在火车上认识新朋友
scenes.english: Meeting a new friend on the train
tags: Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone
Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
quotes: Excuse me. Do you mind? Everywhere else is full.
不好意思，我能坐这儿吗？别的地方都坐满了。
I'm Ron, by the way. Ron Weasley.
对了，我叫罗恩，罗恩·韦斯莱。
So, so it's true? I mean, do you really have the... the...
所以，那些都是真的？我是说，你真的有那个……那个……

scenes.title: 哈利，你是巫师
tags: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
quotes: A wizard. And a thumping good one, I'd wager, once you train up a little.
巫师。稍加训练，你就会成为很棒的巫师。
No. You've made a mistake. I mean, I can't be a wizard. I mean, I'm just Harry. Just Harry.
不，你弄错了。我不可能是巫师。我只是哈利，普通的哈利。

scenes.title: 你念错咒语了
tags: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
quotes: Stop, stop, stop. You're going to take someone's eye out. Besides, you're saying it wrong. It's Leviosa, not Leviosa.
停，你会戳到别人眼睛的。而且你念错了，要这样念。
You do it then if you're so clever. Go on, go on.
Oh, well done! See here, everyone. Miss Granger's done it! Oh, splendid!
做得好！大家看，格兰杰小姐成功了！太棒了！

scenes.title: 这样好多了吧？
scenes.english: That is better, is it not?
tags: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
quotes: For example. Oculus Reparo. That's better, isn't it? Holy cricket, you're Harry Potter. I'm Hermione Granger. And you are?
比如这样。恢复如初。这样好多了吧？天哪，你是哈利·波特。我是赫敏·格兰杰。你呢？
Pleasure. You two better change into robes. I expect we'll be arriving soon.
很高兴认识你。你们最好换上校袍，我们应该快到了。
